name: Multi-head latent attention
change: Keys and values are compressed into one low-rank latent per token, plus a small decoupled RoPE key; per-head K/V are reconstructed from the latent.
problem_solved: KV was still large at long context. Caching a latent of d_c + d_rope elements per layer is far smaller than per-head K/V, without dropping heads.
trade_off: Extra projection compute and a decoupled RoPE path. Engines that cache the decompressed K/V lose the memory benefit.

reference.title: DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Model
